real_corpus.source_attribution: Stanford SQuAD contributors and cited Wikipedia source articles; attribution/link and adaptation notice required
real_corpus.split_policy: Use ONLY published validation parquet for D1 public diagnostic; its questions/answers publicly available, not claimed blind TEST. No train or training on SQuAD.
real_corpus.unit_of_index: One unique (title,context) passage in validation, not a QA row
real_corpus.normalization: Use exact strings supplied by parquet; UTF-8, no punctuation removal; (title,context) duplicates collapsed, SHA256 of UTF8(title) + ASCII newline + UTF8(context) for passage_id
real_corpus.group_id: SHA256 of NFKC(title), one Wikipedia article title = one bootstrap group; do not place article in different splits
real_corpus.query_selection: Per title group, select lexicographically lowest 3 SHA256(UTF8(question_id)) values, or all if <3; no reference to answer, correctness, model or retrieval scores
real_corpus.query_id: Published SQuAD `id`; SHA256 collision tie by literal id ascending
real_corpus.gold_passage_ids: Reference(s) to original canonical context for published QA; may not reflect all semantically relevant passages; primary Hit@3 is source-passage recovery rather than exhaustive relevance.
real_corpus.index_membership: All unique validation contexts for all groups, including groups evaluated. This represents document-known retrieval, not TEST label peeking.
real_corpus.sensitivity: If duplicate/near-duplicate across titles or source id ambiguity, STOP and report, no posthoc resampling.

r_gold_fixture.sample_policy: No tuning or modifying records after any Qwen outputs; if QA finds a defect before science, document successor and new SHA
r_gold_fixture.origin: assistant-authored fictitious evidence on user request, rights owner acceptance and independent content check pending

bm25.tokenization: Python unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', text).casefold(), then re.findall(r'(?u)\b\w+\b', text); no stem or stopword removal
bm25.formula: IDF=ln(1+(N-df+0.5)/(df+0.5)); sum over unique query terms with query term-frequency weight fixed at 1 of IDF * f*(k1+1)/(f+k1*(1-b+b*doc_length/avg_doc_length))

embedding.pooling: model's official sentence-transformers pipeline pinned to same revision

rag_text.role: R3 single Qwen text-RAG generation with the exact top-3 R2 doc IDs
rag_text.evidence: full original context, concatenated in R2 ranking order; no vector fed to Qwen
rag_text.qwen_prompt: frozen system+user template to be pinned against exact revision; no answer metadata in prompt
rag_text.scoring: answer-only teacher-forced NLL + Exact Match; causal correct shift and mask, no prompt loss
rag_text.min_valid_context: Full prompt+all passages+all target tokens fit effective Qwen context for primary S_SHORT; otherwise S_LONG descriptive only

retrieval.primary_retrieval_metric: Hit@3 on original SQuAD source-passage id
retrieval.decision_rule: Paired 95% group-bootstrap CI lower for mean(R2_hit3-R1_hit3)>0 for scoped retrieval improvement; if fails NO_EVIDENCE_OF_SUPERIORITY not general model failure

r_gold_prereg_candidate.primary: mean over 48 groups of within-group mean answer-only NLL(R0)-NLL(R_gold), nats per answer token
r_gold_prereg_candidate.criterion: two-sided paired group bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >0.10; bootstrap 10000 resamples, seed 20261108
r_gold_prereg_candidate.competence_guards: Exact Match(R_gold)>=0.60 AND difference EM(R_gold)-EM(R0)>=0.10; mean NLL(R_wrong)-NLL(R_gold)>0
r_gold_prereg_candidate.abstention_guard: no more than 6 incorrect factual answers among 24 no-answer questions; diagnostic only, NOT population guarantee
r_gold_prereg_candidate.missing_data: any missing/invalid source evidence, answer target, NaN or context overflow invalidates prereg cohort; INCONCLUSIVE, not drop/relabel sample

execution_gates.next: one integrated protocol lock decision; then separately authorized no-science T4 preflight
